function make(key: symbol) {
  const o = { [key]: 1 };
  return o[key];
}
const plain: symbol = Symbol("p");
const pp = { [plain]: 1, name: "pp" };
console.log(pp[plain], pp.name);
let mut = Symbol("m");
const m = { [mut]: "m" };
console.log(m[mut]);
console.log(make(Symbol()));

interface Bag {
  [k: symbol]: number;
}
const u = Symbol("u");
const bag: Bag = { [plain]: 2, [u]: 3 };
console.log(bag[plain], bag[u]);
const read = (b: Bag, k: symbol): number => b[k] ?? 0;
console.log(read(bag, mut));
const getters = {
  get [plain]() {
    return 5;
  },
};
console.log(getters[plain]);
const keys: (keyof Bag)[] = [u, plain];
console.log(keys.length);
